description: Create a new wish list for a child, optionally with first wishes. Returns edit_link (secret, for parents) and share_link (for family).

date.description: Date of the occasion as YYYY-MM-DD (optional).

message.description: Optional message from the parents to everyone giving gifts, shown above the wishes. Line breaks are kept. Empty string removes it.

occasion.description: Free text, any culture or religion, e.g. "Geburtstag", "Weihnachten", "Eid al-Fitr", "Diwali".

image_url.description: Optional direct URL of the main product picture (https://…jpg/png/webp), e.g. the og:image of the product page if you have seen it. Used when the picture cannot be fetched from the page, many shops block our server. Empty string removes it.

link.description: Optional product link. The product picture (and title, if text is empty) is fetched from the page.

price.description: Optional price as text, e.g. "39,99 €". Filled from the product page when a link is given and price is empty. Empty string removes it.

text.description: The wish, short and concrete. Optional if a link is given: then the product title is used.

name: create_wishlist
title: Create wish list
